chunks: From him, from al-Nadr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, and Ali, from Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him)
Regarding forgetfulness in prayer, he said: 'Build upon certainty, proceed with decisiveness, and be cautious with the entire prayer.'

key_terms.السَّهْو: Forgetfulness or inadvertent omission in ritual acts
key_terms.تَحْتَاط: To be cautious or take precaution

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for prayer when one forgets a part of it?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the principle of 'building on certainty' (ibtina' ala al-yaqin) for handling forgetfulness, prioritizing the core structure of the prayer over minor omissions. It reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on maintaining the integrity of the prayer through decisive action and comprehensive caution, ensuring that the worshipper does not invalidate the act by over-correcting minor errors.
